missing.why: The brief gives no outside relative humidity, and the knowledge base's assumptions file gives only the INDOOR relative humidity of the cooled space (26 degC / 50 %, a demand.cooling value), which is not the outside air. It sets the wet-bulb and the air-cooler/cooling-tower duty, so it cannot be left to a typical value.

Neither the requirements PDF nor the assumptions document states a heating value (nor whether it is lower or higher). The handbook's ~50.0 MJ/kg is for pure methane / co-produced gas, not for this grid gas, so it is not used. Without it the boiler/CHP fuel input and the gas bill cannot be computed from the composition alone.
